basic.name: Drag (Q)
basic.description: Dehaka lashes out his tongue, dealing 160 damage to the first enemy hit, Stunning and dragging them with him for 1.75 seconds.If Dehaka is Stunned or Silenced while using Drag, the effect ends.

basic.name: Dark Swarm (W)
basic.description: Deal 52 damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies for 3.5 seconds. While active, you are able to move through units. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.

basic.name: Burrow (E)
basic.description: Burrow into the ground, entering Stasis and becoming Invulnerable for 2 seconds. While Burrowed, Dehaka can move at 50% movement speed.

heroic.name: Isolation (R)
heroic.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

heroic.name: Intimidating Roar (R)
heroic.description: {highlight}After 0.75 second Dehaka terrifies nearby enemies, reducing their movement speed by 75%  for 3 seconds.{/highlight}

trait.name: Essence Collection (T)
trait.description: Heal Dehaka for a small amount per stored Essence over 5 seconds. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.Passive: Gain 10 Essence from Takedowns and 2 Essence from nearby Minions dying. Maximum of 50 Essence.

general.name: Base
general.description: If Dehaka uses Brushstalker and the cooldown is bug reset, a message on the game chat will say 'I failed to adapt'.
general.developerCommentary: There's currently a bug that when Dehaka uses Brushstalker on a bush on his own hitbox he will perform the Brushstalker but will have his cooldown reset so instead of fixing it im going for a joke.

1.name: Evolve Mutation
rewards: {highlight}Dehaka gets 0.5% bigger for every 50 essence collected up to 25%{/highlight}
subtexts: The objective here is mean't to be Kaiju based similar to how he is portrayed on the coop missions from SC2

1.name: Tissue Regeneration
1.description: Regeneration Globes grant 10 Essence.{repeatable_quest}Repeatable Quest:{/repeatable_quest} Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases Health Regeneration by 4, up to 40, and maximum Essence by 1, up to 10.

1.name: Enhanced Agility
1.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 5 seconds after leaving a bush.{repeatable_quest}Repeatable Quest:{/repeatable_quest} Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

4.name: Lurker Strain
4.description: Emerging from Burrow grants Dehaka Stealth for 3 seconds and knocks nearby enemies back, dealing 125 damage and Slowing them by 30% for 3 seconds.Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Burrow by 3 seconds.

4.name: One-Who-Collects
4.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries. {highlight}Exceeding essence will be automatically used by Dehaka{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: I wanted to make it more competitive with the other talents but on other way without going for numerical changes

4.name: Hero Stalker
4.description: Increases Essence gained from Takedowns by 100%, and gain 1 Essence each time an enemy Hero is hit by Dark Swarm.

7.name: Feeding Frenzy
7.description: Basic Attacks reduce Drag's cooldown by 1.5 seconds.Passive: Increase Drag's duration by 0.5 seconds.

7.name: Devour
7.description: {highlight}Drag against troops or non-boss mercenaries will turn them unkillable during the drag duration and will grab enemies around the target. After that duration it will instantly kill the primary target{/highlight}
subtexts: I wanted to make a playmaking tool for Drag but didn't want it to be eazily abused so i made a level 7 spike for that type of talent mixing two talents i wanted to create.

7.name: Symbiosis
7.description: Every time Dark Swarm damages an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 0.4 seconds. {highlight}Every time Dark Swarm hits an enemy hero it also extends Brushstalker duration by 0.5 second if it's active{/highlight}
subtexts: This change is made to make 2º option talent for picking <vanilla, talents, 13, 0> without the need of <vanilla, talents, 1, 2>

10.name: Isolation
10.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

10.name: Intimidating Roar
10.description: {highlight}After 0.75 second Dehaka terrifies nearby enemies, reducing their movement speed by 75%  for 3 seconds.{/highlight}
10.developerCommentary: For me this feels like a strong talent rather than a ultimate and that's the most important WHY i am changing it

13.name: Ferocious Stalker
13.description: Dark Swarm Slows enemy Heroes by 15% for 0.75 seconds and deals 60% more damage while Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus is active.

13.name: Primal Swarm
13.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds.{highlight}While active, it grants Dehaka 25 Spell Armor and extends its duration by 0.2 seconds per enemy hero hit.{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: With the removal of <vanilla, talents, 1, 0> and changes to <vanilla, talents, 10, 1> i am buffing changing that talent to cover it.

13.name: Primal Rage
13.description: Gain 1.25% increased Attack Damage {highlight}and 0.4% slow for 1 second on basic attacks{/highlight} per Essence stored.
13.developerCommentary: Buffing it a little to make it more competitive with <vanilla, talents, 13, 0> while also covering the removal of <vanilla, talents, 20, 2>

16.name: Tunneling Claws
16.description: Increase movement speed while Burrowing to 125%.

16.name: Adaptation
16.description: {highlight}After 4 seconds, heal for 50% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.{/highlight}

16.name: Apex Predator
16.description: Reduces Brushstalker's cooldown by {highlight}35{/highlight} seconds and the cast time by 0.5 seconds.
16.developerCommentary: by bringing <modified, talents, 16, 2> to level 16 this doesn't feel necessary anymore

20.name: Contagion
20.description: Isolation hits all Heroes near the first target.

20.name: Survival Instinct
20.description: {highlight}Intimidating Roar will reduce enemy heroes armor by 25.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: The area is enormous and that effect is strong combined with such a strong slow

20.name: Leap
20.description: {highlight}Leap to target location after 0.5 seconds, dealing 246 damage to enemies on landing also stunning them for 0.25.{/highlight}
subtexts: Even tho we could argue that it overlaps with <vanilla, talents, 10, 0, sonya> it's not something that would bother that much as it's not an ultimate powerhouse

20.name: Scorching Breath
20.description: {highlight}Dehaka's fiery breath scorches the earth, creating a scorching area, dealing 50 damage every 0.5 seconds and reducing 50% healing on the area.The area lasts 4 seconds.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: Made level 20 a place where how you want to customize your kaiju so there's no place for a talent like this
